title: A Joint LLM and Optimization Agent Solution for Drone Scheduling in Victim Search Missions
abstract: arXiv:2611.16524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Victim search in wilderness areas is time-critical. Drones enable rapid area search, but scheduling them is challenging because victims may continue moving, detection results are uncertain, and effective decisions must combine structured mission information with unstructured contextual clues and domain knowledge. To address this, we propose an agent-aided drone scheduling system. The system employs an agent at the ground control station (GCS) to coordinate multiple drones over successive search cycles. In each cycle, the agent applies a scheduling policy that combines a large language model (LLM) for reasoning about where to search with an optimizer for determining how to dispatch the drones under energy constraints. Simulation results show that the proposed system consistently completes the victim-search mission, whereas none of the six non-LLM baselines does so and direct LLM scheduling is considerably less reliable. translated_title: 一种用于受害者搜索任务中无人机调度的LLM与优化联合智能体解决方案
translated_abstract: 野外区域的受害者搜救具有很强的时间紧迫性。无人机能够实现快速的区域搜索，但调度无人机极具挑战性，因为受害者可能持续移动，检测结果存在不确定性，且有效的决策必须将结构化的任务信息与非结构化的上下文线索和领域知识相结合。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种智能体辅助的无人机调度系统。该系统在地面控制站（GCS）部署一个智能体，在连续的搜索周期中协调多架无人机。在每个周期中，该智能体采用一种调度策略，将大语言模型（LLM）用于推理“在哪里搜索”，同时利用优化器确定“如何在能量约束下派遣无人机”。仿真结果表明，所提出的系统能够持续完成受害者搜索任务，而六个非LLM基线方法均无法做到，直接使用LLM进行调度的可靠性也明显较低。
tldr: 提出一种结合大语言模型推理与优化器的智能体辅助无人机调度系统，在能量约束下协调多架无人机执行野外受害者搜索任务，仿真证明其能持续完成任务，而六个非LLM基线方法均告失败。
en_tdlr: Proposes an agent-aided drone scheduling system combining LLM reasoning with an optimizer to coordinate multiple drones under energy constraints for wilderness victim search, which consistently completes missions where all six non-LLM baselines fail.
